title: Fourteenth stale-suite triage draw: ranks 1-20 of the verdict-aware ranking, 20 directories, 20 drawn files, each executed, verdicts only

scope.drawnFrom: governedRiskRanking ranks 1-20 of docs/architecture/test-ci-coverage-census.json on the base. The census reports 0 critical and 0 high directories left, so all 20 are band unclassified and the order within the band is path order.
scope.everyFileWasExecuted: Each file was run on its own with npx jest --runTestsByPath <file> --no-coverage --ci on the base. Counts are what jest printed, never read from the census.
scope.readOnly: No workflow, baseline or test file is changed by this record. The census is regenerated so the 20 files are held out of the next draw with their verdicts published.

secondHalf.what: Wire the wire_into_ci rows (by named file where the directory is partly covered), apply the LivingMoveView label update and wire it, and leave the Tower byte scan and the ProofPointFooter render held until their owners act.
secondHalf.reExecuteFirst: Re-execute every row on the then-current main before wiring; this record is a snapshot at its base.
secondHalf.status: wire_into_ci rows wired; the LivingMoveView label update applied and wired; two held rows unchanged
secondHalf.reExecuted: All 17 wire_into_ci files re-executed together on the wiring base: 17 suites, 80 cases, all green. The two workflow steps run as written: 15 suites / 64 cases and 2 suites / 16 cases.
steps: Run the T-799 route handler, setup, programs and strategic-moves suites
Run the T-799 docs page and Source request-first suites by named file

suites.rationale: Green 2 of 2, behavioural, reads no repository file. Renders the /docs page and its src/lib/help-center/product-docs model; the page is an App Router route. Not wired in this change: the draw is read-only and the wiring is T-799's second half.

Red 1 of 4. All four cases read route source with fs.readFileSync and assert literals over its bytes. The red case expects the three-line form 'const requestedClient =\n    trustedTenant?.clientKey ??\n    rawRequestedClient;' in src/app/(maestro)/tower/page.tsx; the page now holds the same expression on one line (page.tsx:91), so the behaviour is unchanged and a formatter reflow turned the case red. The subject is a tenant-scope control on the Tower route: that the tenant route authorises through assertTenantAccess and that the generic route prefers the trusted tenant's clientKey over the query string. That is worth asserting, but by rendering the route with a mocked resolver and observing which client key reaches getActiveClientRow, not by matching whitespace. Not wired: a byte scan in a merge-blocking step fails on formatting and passes on a comment.

Red 2 of 8, behavioural. Both red cases look for a case-switcher tab labelled 'First Capital Financial'; the switcher renders 'Apex Retail', 'Meridian Health System' and 'FS Demo', because src/lib/programs/expert-kernel/living-move-cases.ts relabelled that case in #4997 (2026-07-17) and the test was never updated. The other 6 cases pass. The component is reached from src/app/(maestro)/strategic-moves/living/page.tsx. Update the two expectations to the current label with this reason, then wire; the label change was a deliberate data change, not a regression.
